```{r, LoadLibraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
```


```{r}
count.df <- read.csv(file = "data/counts.csv", header = TRUE,row.names = 1)
meta_data.df <- read.csv(file = "data/meta_data.csv", header = TRUE)
```

```{r, DataWrangling, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Recommended 10-gene core BRCA/HR variant panel For mutation/variant analysis
genes.of.interest <- c("ENSG00000012048.23","ENSG00000139618.16",
                       "ENSG00000083093.10","ENSG00000138376.11",
                       "ENSG00000108384.15", "ENSG00000185379.20",
                       "ENSG00000136492.9", "ENSG00000149311.19",
                       "ENSG00000183765.23", "ENSG00000167258.15")

count.df.subset <- count.df %>%
  filter(rownames(.) %in% genes.of.interest)

count.df.matrix <- as.matrix(count.df.subset[,])

# Rename from Ensebml ID to Gene
rownames(count.df.matrix) <- c("BRCA1", "BRCA2", "PALB2", "BARD1", "RAD51C",
                               "RAD51D", "BRIP1", "ATM", "CHEK2", "CDK12")

```

```{r}

rownames(count.df.subset) <- c("BRCA1", "BRCA2", "PALB2", "BARD1", "RAD51C",
                               "RAD51D", "BRIP1", "ATM", "CHEK2", "CDK12")

```

```{r}

count.df.subset %>% 
  mutate(row_mean = rowMeans(select(., where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  select(last_col())

```

```{r}

count.df.subset.long <- count.df.subset %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Gene") %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Gene, 
    names_to = "Sample", 
    values_to = "Counts"
  )

```

```{r}

meta_data.df.corrected <- meta_data.df %>% mutate(barcode = str_replace_all(barcode, "-", "."))

count.df.subset.enriched <- count.df.subset.long %>%
  inner_join(., meta_data.df.corrected_2, by = c("Sample" = "barcode"))

```

```{r}
# Define your target strings
targets <- c("Adjuvant", "Anastrozole", "First-Line Therapy", "Carboplatin","Paclitaxel")
pattern <- paste(targets, collapse = "|")

# Extract the matching string into a new column
meta_data.df.corrected_2 <- meta_data.df.corrected %>% 
  mutate(treatment_method = str_extract(treatments, pattern))
```


```{r}

count.df.subset.enriched %>%
  filter(Gene == 'BRCA1') %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x=Counts, fill = treatment_method)) +
    geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5, binwidth = 100) +
     labs(
        title = "Distribution of BRCA1 Gene Counts",
        x = "Counts",
        y = "Count (Frequency)"
)

```

```{r}

df1 <- count.df.subset.enriched %>%
  filter(sample_type == "Primary Tumor") %>%
  #group_by(Gene, treatment_method) %>%
  #summarise(mean_value = mean(Counts, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(Counts, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(Gene, treatment_method)) #%>%
  #ungroup()

```

```{r, message=FALSE}

df2 <- count.df.subset.enriched %>%
  filter(sample_type == "Primary Tumor") %>%
  group_by(Gene, treatment_method) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(Counts, na.rm = TRUE)) #%>%
  #summarise(mean_value = mean(Counts), .by = c(Gene, treatment_method)) #%>%
```

```{r, message=FALSE}

df3 <- count.df.subset.enriched %>%
  group_by(sample_type, Gene, treatment_method) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(Counts, na.rm = TRUE))


```

```{r}

ggplot(df3, aes(x = treatment_method, y = mean_value, fill = Gene)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = "dodge") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 10000)) #+
  #facet_wrap(~sample_type)

```


```{r}

model <- lm(mean_value ~ treatment_method + Gene, data = df3)

summary(model)
anova(model)

AIC(model)

```

## Heatmap
```{r}
# Number of samples to choose in column space of count matrix
n <- 30

count.df.matrix.subset <- count.df.matrix[,1:n]

# Number of rows of the metadata need to match the number of columns of the count matrix
meta_data.df.subset <- meta_data.df[1:n,c(1,10,23,25,26, 27,29)]

```

```{r}

# Define your target strings
targets <- c("Adjuvant", "Anastrozole", "First-Line Therapy", "Carboplatin","Paclitaxel")
pattern <- paste(targets, collapse = "|")

# Extract the matching string into a new column
meta_data.final.df <- meta_data.df.subset %>% 
  mutate(treatment_method = str_extract(treatments, pattern))

```

```{r}
# Define color schemes for all annotations
colour_list <- list(
  laterality = colorRamp2(c(18, 45, 90), c("Left" = "blue", "Right" = "orange", "NA" = "yellow")),
  sample_type = colorRamp2(c(18, 90), c("Primary Tumor" = "red","Solid Tissue Normal" = "green")),
  #sample_type = colorRamp2(c(20, 100), c("red","green")),
  treatment_method = c("Adjuvant" = "white", "Anastrozole" = "lightblue",
                       "Carboplatin" = "lightpink", "First-Line Therapy" = "darkred", 
                       "NA" = "blue")
)
```

```{r}

# Create top annotation for continuous variables
top_ann <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Laterality = meta_data.final.df$laterality,
  Sample_type = meta_data.final.df$sample_type,
  
  col = colour_list,
     na_col = "blue",
     gp = gpar(col = "green"),
  
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Laterality = list(title = "Laterality"),
    Sample_type = list(title = "Sample Type")
  )
)

# Create bottom annotation for treatment variables
bottom_ann <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Treatment_Method = meta_data.final.df$treatment_method,
  
  col = colour_list,
     na_col = "blue",
     gp = gpar(col = "white"),

  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
 
)

```

```{r}
# Heatmap with annotations
annotated_heatmap <- Heatmap(
  count.df.matrix.subset,
  name = "Expression",
  
  # Clustering parameters
  clustering_distance_rows = "spearman",
  clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
  clustering_distance_columns = "spearman",
  clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
  
  #col = colour_list,
  
  top_annotation = top_ann,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_ann,
  
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  
  column_title = "Gene Expression"
)

draw(annotated_heatmap)
```
